items.summary: Add a visible and functional 'Undo last ball' button on the Live Scoring page that removes the most recently recorded ball from the current innings ball history and updates all displayed scoreboard values (runs, wickets, overs, balls) accordingly, with support for both local-only matches and backend-synced matches.

Fix the Live Scoring page state reload behavior so that navigating away to Match Stats (or any other page) and then returning to Live Scoring does not reset the striker and non-striker selections or require re-selecting batsmen, preserving the current batting state across navigation.

Replace the existing 'Last Over' summary on the Live Scoring screen with a comprehensive over-by-over breakdown that displays runs scored in each individual completed over (1st over, 2nd over, 3rd over, etc.) throughout the current innings, not just the most recent over, so the scorer can see the full scoring progression.
